c9fd14ae09.q: When did the United States stop being a major chemical producer and how did China become the dominant exporter?

50c7fe126e.q: How much federal funding did BioMADE receive to launch and what is the Manufacturing USA program?
50c7fe126e.a: BioMADE started through the Manufacturing USA program with almost $90 million in federal funding over five years in 2020. Manufacturing USA is a federal program, now 17-18 years old, where the federal government identifies manufacturing technology areas of national importance and has established 18 institutes around the country focused on different manufacturing technology areas, with the first one based in Ohio focused on additive manufacturing and 3D printing.
